verdict.rationale: Bitwarden describes itself as an open source password manager. Community users say they chose it specifically because the clients are not closed source. The SDK licensing controversy ended with Bitwarden relicensing back to a free/open license, so the open-source status of its client code is supported rather than contradicted. Missing for 10: first-party docs linking the client app source repositories and their licenses, and evidence of independent audits or community code review of the TOTP/seed-handling code.
